scripts.local:up: docker compose --project-name feet-local --env-file infra/local.env up -d --build --wait web
scripts.local:dev: docker compose --project-name feet-local --env-file infra/local.env watch web
scripts.local:down: docker compose --project-name feet-local --env-file infra/local.env --profile test --profile tools down
scripts.local:migrate: docker compose --project-name feet-local --env-file infra/local.env run --rm migrate
scripts.local:seed: docker compose --project-name feet-local --env-file infra/local.env run --rm seed
scripts.local:test: docker compose --project-name feet-local --env-file infra/local.env run --build --rm test
